Gate a candidate on validation score and rank stability

Source: R/vgc-gate.R
vgc_gate.Rd

Admit a candidate only if the validation ranking is sufficiently stable and the candidate is no worse than the incumbent by more than the tolerance. Tolerance is .tau_min + (1 - .rho_hat) * (.tau_max - .tau_min). A FALSE decision leaves fallback exploration to the caller.

Usage

vgc_gate(
  .incumbent_score,
  .candidate_score,
  .rho_hat,
  .tau_min = 0.002,
  .tau_max = 0.02,
  .min_rho = 0.6,
  .maximize = TRUE
)

Arguments

.incumbent_score, .candidate_score

Numeric scalar validation scores on the same data and scale.

.rho_hat

Rank-stability estimate in [-1, 1], for example from check_validation_stability().

.tau_min, .tau_max

Non-negative tolerance bounds in score units, with .tau_min no larger than .tau_max. Set them equal for a fixed tolerance.

.min_rho

Minimum rank stability in [0, 1].

.maximize

Logical scalar. Use FALSE for losses such as RMSE.

Value

One logical value. FALSE includes abstention when a score or the stability estimate is missing or non-finite.

Examples

vgc_gate(0.82, 0.817, .rho_hat = 0.9)
#> [1] TRUE
vgc_gate(1.10, 1.05, .rho_hat = 0.8, .maximize = FALSE)
#> [1] TRUE
